aboutGame.title: What is Moon Sweepers?
paragraphs: Moon Sweepers is a lunar cleaning simulation by DragDrop Games. Start with a toothbrush, sweep dust from the Moon, carry it to a depot, and launch shipments to earn money. Play alone or team up online with a crew of up to 16 players.

Spend your earnings on cleaning tools, carrying capacity, and vehicles as your operation expands. Place depots near your work to shorten delivery trips, then track your progress across the changing lunar surface.

items.question: What is Moon Sweepers?
items.answer: Moon Sweepers is a lunar cleaning simulation by DragDrop Games. Sweep lunar dust, send shipments from depots, and spend your earnings on tools and vehicles. You can play solo or in online co-op.

items.question: What should I do first in Moon Sweepers?
items.answer: Use your starting toothbrush to clean nearby lunar dust, carry it to a depot, and launch a shipment. Reinvest the money in a better cleaning tool or more capacity.

items.question: How do I earn money in Moon Sweepers?
items.answer: Collect lunar dust and deliver it to a depot for a paid shipment. Better tools, more carrying capacity, and depots near your work can make each cleaning trip more productive.

items.question: Can I play Moon Sweepers with friends?
items.answer: Yes. Moon Sweepers supports single-player and online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Crew members can split up or clean the same area together.

items.question: Where can I play Moon Sweepers?
items.answer: Moon Sweepers is available on Steam for Windows PC. It was released on October 23, 2026, and is developed and published by DragDrop Games.
